tools.name: surelc_list_changed_producers
tools.description: List producers created or updated recently, with their key data (ids, names, NPN, status). Without `after`, SureLC returns the last 24 hours. Use this to find a producer id. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/.

tools.name: surelc_get_producer
tools.description: Get one producer by SureLC id: name, NPN, status, branch and contact details. Personal fields are removed. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/{id}.

tools.name: surelc_get_producer_by_npn
tools.description: Find one producer by National Producer Number (NPN). SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/npn/{npn}.

tools.name: surelc_list_producers_licenses
tools.description: List license records for all producers, changed after an optional date. Use it to find expiring or missing licenses. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/licenses.

tools.name: surelc_list_producer_licenses
tools.description: List the licenses of one producer: state, license number, type and expiry. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/{id}/licenses.

tools.name: surelc_list_producer_appointments
tools.description: List carrier appointments of one producer. Pass `status` to filter (active, appointed, obsolete, terminated). SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/{id}/appointments and /appointments/{status}.

tools.name: surelc_list_producer_appointment_requests
tools.description: List appointment requests of one producer. Pass `carrier_naic` to show only one carrier. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/{id}/appointment-requests and /carrier/{carrierNaic}.

tools.name: surelc_list_producer_training_courses
tools.description: List the training courses of one producer, with completion status. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/{id}/courses.

tools.name: surelc_list_producer_errors_and_omissions
tools.description: List the errors and omissions (E&O) policies of one producer. Set `active` to true for current policies only. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/{id}/eno and /eno/active.

tools.name: surelc_list_producer_employment_addresses
tools.description: List the employment (business) addresses of one producer. Residential addresses are not included. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/{id}/addresses/employment.

tools.name: surelc_list_firms
tools.description: List all firms (agencies) in the account with their key data. SureLC: GET /api/v2/firms/.

tools.name: surelc_get_firm
tools.description: Get one firm by SureLC id: name, EIN, NPN, status and contact details. SureLC: GET /api/v2/firms/{id}.

tools.name: surelc_get_firm_by_ein
tools.description: Find one firm by its federal employer identification number (EIN). SureLC: GET /api/v2/firms/ein/{ein}.

tools.name: surelc_get_firm_by_npn
tools.description: Find one firm by its National Producer Number (NPN). SureLC: GET /api/v2/firms/npn/{npn}.

tools.name: surelc_list_firm_appointments
tools.description: List carrier appointments of one firm. Pass `status` to filter (active, appointed, obsolete, terminated). SureLC: GET /api/v2/firms/{id}/appointments and /appointments/{status}.

tools.name: surelc_list_firm_licenses
tools.description: List the business licenses of one firm. SureLC: GET /api/v2/firms/{id}/licenses.

tools.name: surelc_list_firm_addresses
tools.description: List the business addresses of one firm. SureLC: GET /api/v2/firms/{id}/addresses.

tools.name: surelc_list_appointment_requests
tools.description: List appointment requests across the account. Page with `offset` and `limit`. SureLC: GET /api/v2/appointment-requests/.

tools.name: surelc_get_appointment_request
tools.description: Get one appointment request by id: carrier, product, status and dates. SureLC: GET /api/v2/appointment-requests/{id}.

tools.name: surelc_list_appointment_request_notes
tools.description: List the notes written on one appointment request. SureLC: GET /api/v2/appointment-requests/{id}/notes.

tools.name: surelc_list_contracts
tools.description: List carrier contracts in the account, changed after an optional date. SureLC: GET /api/v2/contracts/.

tools.name: surelc_list_producer_contracts
tools.description: List the carrier contracts of one producer. SureLC: GET /api/v2/contracts/producer/{producerId}.

tools.name: surelc_list_carriers
tools.description: List the carriers (insurance companies) known to SureLC, with their NAIC codes and ids. SureLC: GET /api/v2/lookup/carriers.

tools.name: surelc_get_carrier
tools.description: Get one carrier by SureLC carrier id. SureLC: GET /api/v2/lookup/carriers/{carrierId}.

tools.name: surelc_list_lookup
tools.description: List one reference list used by SureLC: stages, stage statuses, appointment request types, products, company types, W-9 company types or entity types. SureLC: GET /api/v2/lookup/{name}.
